eaf4f222302640f7.cover_headline: Google just rewrote their own docs. Here's why.
eaf4f222302640f7.cover_body: Their edits show exactly what makes content easier to rank.

slides.headline: Vague → precise
slides.body: Google swapped "responds quickly" for "response times remain stable." General fluff got cut. Specifics stayed.

slides.headline: "Server errors" is now "5xx codes"
slides.body: Every fuzzy term got a concrete replacement. "Every URL" → "every publicly accessible URL." Details matter.

slides.headline: Cut the "why," show the effect
slides.body: Old: "calculated to provide coverage." New: "ensures Google can cover." Readers want outcomes, not explanations.

slides.headline: Comprehension road bumps
slides.body: Sentences with clashing ideas make readers re-read. Google removed them. If humans pause, so does their algorithm.

slides.headline: Short ≠ clear
slides.body: Not about sentence length. One idea per sentence, logically ordered. That's what Google actually fixed.

eaf4f222302640f7.cta_headline: Clearer pages. But are visitors staying?
eaf4f222302640f7.cta_body: Good content gets them there — LeadYup turns that attention into contacts before they bounce.
